cohort: The study included patients with Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus, Gestational Diabetes Mellitus, and Preeclampsia, along with healthy pregnant and non-pregnant controls.
finding: No significant association was observed between SIRT1 polymorphisms (rs12778366 and rs3758391) and Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus, Gestational Diabetes Mellitus, or Preeclampsia.
